messages:
nina-docs: Heads upI opened a short PR to add redaction examples and a Go SDK snippet for evidence exports. Need compliance + legal sign-off on SOC2 phrasing. PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/761 :wave:

 tom-compliance: Looking. Two quick items: (1) use "actor_id" in examples to match audit templates, (2) retention defaults need to be explicit for auditors.

 nina-docs: Draft uses actor_id. Retention table in the draft shows hosted=90d, dedicated=365d, private=customer-configurable. Is that ok?

 kelly-legal: Hosted 90d is fine. For public docs use language: "default retention" and avoid contractual sounding words. Also change any URIs to placeholders.

 nina-docs: Replaced URIs with "REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI" placeholders. Added short note: "Do not publish full storage URIs; internal retrieval steps live in the SOC2 runbook."

 ana-eng: Quick review of Go snippet: please show pagination example and error handling. Suggest:

```go
it := client.ListExports(ctx, &ListExportsParams{PageSize:50})
for it.Next() {
  e := it.Value()
  fmt.Println(e.EvidenceRef)
}
if err := it.Err(); err != nil {
  log.Fatal(err)
}
```

Also avoid printing raw evidence_ref in public snippets.

 nina-docs: Updated snippet to include token/pagination and replaced printing with logging of sanitized ID only.

 tom-compliance: For SOC2 wording, prefer "must be encrypted at rest and in transit" rather than "should". Also add footnote: key rotation recommended every 90 days for high-sensitivity exports.

 kelly-legal: Add sentence instructing customers to remove embedded credentials from export metadata. Provide a tiny before/after example: one-line unsanitized vs sanitized.

 nina-docs: Added sanitized example:

Unsanitized: {"evidence_ref":"s3://customer-bucket/ev-2026-01-01?X-Amz-Credential=..."}
Sanitized:   {"evidence_ref":"REDACTED_EVIDENCE_URI"}

And added migration note: "If you previously exposed `export_uri` in logs, run the provided migration script to replace with `evidence_ref` placeholders. See internal KB: /kb/ml/compliance/export-migration"

 ana-eng: Can you include the migration CLI snippet I wrote? `./tools/sanitize-exports --dry-run` with a sample output line. Keeps things actionable.

 nina-docs: Included CLI example and sample output. Marked the CLI as internal-only.

 docbot: PR #761 updated by nina-docs https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/761/commits/5b9c

 tom-compliance: LGTM once the "must be encrypted" language and rotation footnote are present.

 kelly-legal: Legal approves the placeholder wording and sanitized example.

 nina-docs: Thanks all I'll merge after one last CI doc lint pass. Publishing note: this will go out in patch release 1.12.1 with changelog entry "clarify export redaction and SDK pagination examples".

 tom-compliance: Approved. Merge when green. :shipit:

 nina-docs: Merged and published. Release ID: 1.12.1. :tada:
